description: Free during beta. Find OPEN public tenders (deadline still in the future) by keywords, country, region, CPV sector and value. EU-wide from TED; for Portugal also every national call for tender of any value (Diário da República). Returns title, buyer, country, region, CPV codes, estimated value, submission deadline, official link and tender documents link, plus 'competition': how contested this buyer's past contracts in the same kind of work were (median bidders, single-bid share, median % below the estimate, sample size). Use bid_intelligence for a price range and rivals.

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes where the work is performed, e.g. ["PT","ES"]

cpv_prefixes.description: CPV code prefixes; '45' = construction, '72' = IT services, '3021' = computers

keywords.description: What you are looking for. English works across all countries (matched via the EU CPV vocabulary); adding the same words in the target country's language (e.g. 'school renovation escola requalificação') also matches tender titles and descriptions.

region.description: Place name: district or municipality (e.g. 'Lisboa', 'Sintra'). Matches the work location or the buyer's name; most precise for Portugal.

name: search_tenders
